r1-handoff.finding: ANTI-RIG (most important): traced observation_features() (fp_representativeness.py:277-308) -- computed ONLY from (latent.fuel_kg_est, latent.compound, latent.run_purpose, track_evolution, session_max_track_evolution). Therefore learned_weight() returns the SAME scalar for every observation under ANY fitted params, mathematically forcing the weighted mean to the plain arithmetic mean regardless of what fit_weight_params converges to -- this is a structural proof, not an empirical accident. Clock genuinely wins because it reads real signal (hours_to_q 1.0 near vs 20.0 far x2, exp-decay weight ratio 0.96 single near vs 0.872 combined far) that the fixture deliberately gives ONLY to clock. Reproduced: 36/36 pass incl. NULL. LEAKAGE: fit_weight_params(train_weekends,...) closes over no other data source; run_lowo excludes held_out from train before calling it; both dedicated shuffle tests (direct + through run_lowo) pass, confirming byte-identical fitted params. DIVERGENT-CASE NORMALIZATION: _min_max_normalize is applied identically/symmetrically to both norm_learned and norm_clock over the same pooled set -- an arm-agnostic scale fix (clock=unbounded exp decay vs learned=bounded logistic), not a thumb on the scale; documented TDD RED (false HONEST_NULL on raw-scale diff) substantiates it was a genuine bug fix. NO session-type hardcoding: clock_weight/learned_weight source-scanned (session_type absent); only build_gate_observations uses session_type, purely for leakage-guarded track-evolution session-max bucketing. Both channels present (evaluate_gate=PRIMARY, secondary_power_gate=SECONDARY/matched-sigma-or-confounded). Protocol sections 1/4/5/6/7/8 (LOWO, paired bootstrap, divergent read, emergence, leakage, sandbagging) all implemented and tested.
